searchText: <@199561711278227457> I'm not sure if anyone has raised this yet, but we're seeing slow responses from `rpc.hoodi.ethpandaops.io`. We were only using it for metamask and that was being slow. gonna bump it to have some more rss our rpc endpoints aren't meant to be used as prod btw its just meant to be a temp solution while other rpc providers get their endpoints up. kinda like a bootstrapper We were just adding the network to metamask via the https://hoodi.ethpandaops.io/ page. yeah are there any other rpcs online already? Happy to change the default url Chainstack announced a new hoodi rpc in the `Hoodi genesis validators` TG chat this morning https://docs.chainstack.com/changelog/chainstack-updates-may-7-2025 Thats not public afaik? Ah fair enough! Then no i dont know any stable rpcs for hoodi.
